description: Explain a No data header (window-in-existing-wall, Window 1 selected): the model's real answer, kept whole.
question: why is this header No data?
reply: No data means napkin has no table to look in, not that the window is wrong [[ref:Header check, Window 1]]. The Connecticut pack you chose carries the state's amendments, but its base IRC tables are not loaded yet [[ref:Its base tables are not loaded]]. Nothing is guessed: someone has to add the missing table from a copy of the code before napkin can size this header, exactly as [[ref:Data status: no real tables ship]] says.
